_doc: Dishes this estate has already ruled on. Read by sourcers BEFORE fetching and by adjudicators as prior art. Written by the DECIDER only - it is already the single writer of selection state. Advisory: a sourcer may return a previously-rejected dish with a stated reason.
_key: protein|method|sauce-family - identity, not slug, because slugs vary by publisher and the same dinner recurs under many names.

dishes.name: Bacon Cheeseburger Egg Casserole
dishes.reason: Same cheeseburger-beef dinner as accepted keto-cheeseburger-skillet; egg-custard bake vs skillet is a format re-plating, not a new dish. Second American low-carb cheeseburger beef entry in one run; catalog already American-heavy.

dishes.name: Beef Cauliflower Taco Skillet
dishes.reason: Near-dupe of catalog loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls: shares protein (ground beef), Tex-Mex taco flavor family, and skillet method; cauliflower-rice swap is the only structural change. Catalog Tex-Mex beef lane is already dense (loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls, tex-mex-beef-rice-skillet-bowls, beef-enchilada-skillet-bowls) so it deepens not widens; plus 34g carbs sits ~1g under the ceiling and a label-accurate recompute (15oz black beans) risks breaching 35g. Cut - run does not need padding.

dishes.name: Beef Egg Roll In A Bowl
dishes.reason: Third protein-swap of an existing catalog dish: pork-egg-roll-in-a-bowl and turkey-egg-roll-in-a-bowl-over-rice both live. Same identity (ground meat + cabbage + soy/hoisin/sesame/ginger stir-fry); beef adds no new dinner.

dishes.name: Broccoli Smoked Sausage Cheddar Bake
dishes.reason: Dupe of accepted baked-cauliflower-mac-smoked-sausage: same smoked-sausage + cruciferous-floret + cheddar/cream low-carb oven bake (floret swap only). Also collides with accepted sheet-pan-smoked-sausage-broccoli-cheddar and keto-turkey-broccoli-cheddar-casserole.

dishes.name: Broccoli Smoked Sausage Cream Cheese Bake
dishes.reason: Pool twin of kept sheet-pan-smoked-sausage-broccoli-cheddar (same protein+broccoli+cheddar, method differs) AND cross-protein twin of accepted keto-turkey-broccoli-cheddar-casserole (same rice-free creamy broccoli-cheddar oven bake); weaker at 20g protein. Ship only the dry sheet-pan.

dishes.name: Buffalo Chicken Cauliflower Casserole
dishes.reason: Near-dupe of accepted chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake: chicken+cauliflower+creamy-cheese-bacon bake, only sauce differs (buffalo vs ranch)

dishes.name: Burmese Chicken Dal Curry
dishes.reason: not carried in Omaha: yellow split peas

dishes.name: Cheese Smothered Pork Chops
dishes.reason: Pool dupe of accepted creamy-garlic-herb-wine-pork-chops: same protein (pork chops), same starch (none/low-carb), same smothered/creamy method - 3 of 4 identity axes; only sauce sub-type differs (mayo-cheddar bake vs garlic-herb-wine cream). Generic American, widens nothing; keep the stronger wine plate, not two smothered pork chops.

dishes.name: Chicken Chasseur

dishes.name: Chicken Tinga Shredded Chipotle

dishes.name: Chimichurri Flank Steak
dishes.reason: Dupe of accepted chimichurri-steak-sheet-pan (same Argentine chimichurri whole-muscle beef); flank vs skirt/sheet-pan is not a distinguishing plate; adjudicator concurred

dishes.name: Coq Au Vin Braised Chicken
dishes.reason: Catalog dup of coq-au-vin: same chicken-thigh + bacon + mushroom + carrot red-wine braise, near-identical name.

dishes.name: Creamy Asiago Pork Tenderloin Medallions
dishes.reason: Cross-lane dupe of accepted creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet: same Tuscan/Marry-Me cream + sun-dried tomato + spinach no-starch skillet; only protein (pork vs chicken) and asiago-vs-parmesan differ (3/4 match).

dishes.name: Creamy Garlic Bacon Spinach Chicken Skillet
dishes.reason: Dupe of accepted creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet: same one-skillet creamy garlic chicken + spinach, no starch (4/4 protein/sauce/starch/method); bacon-vs-sundried-tomato is garnish-level. Tuscan is stronger (published macros).

dishes.name: Creamy Garlic Chicken Skillet
dishes.reason: Dupe of accepted creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet: same seared chicken-breast + garlic cream skillet, no starch. Tuscan version (fully mapped) holds the slot.

dishes.name: Creamy Garlic Herb Pork Chops
dishes.reason: Cross-lane dup of accepted creamy-garlic-herb-wine-pork-chops: identical source URL, servings, macros and ingredient list - same recipe scraped twice. Adjudicator KEEP overruled (it never saw the sibling accepted from another lane).

dishes.name: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Mushroom Chicken Skillet
dishes.reason: Dupe of accepted creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet family: seared chicken breast in garlic-parmesan cream skillet, no starch; mushroom/onion adds no distinct plate. Re-anchored from adjudicator ref creamy-garlic-parmesan-chicken-skillet (not in accepted-slugs) to the accepted tuscan skillet.

dishes.name: Creamy Mushroom Spinach Pork Chops Skillet
dishes.reason: Dupe of catalog creamy-mushroom-pork-chops-over-mashed-potatoes: same white heavy-cream mushroom pork chop, seared+simmered skillet; dropping mash + adding spinach are side tweaks not a new dinner.

dishes.name: Creamy Parmesan Garlic Pork Chops Skillet
dishes.reason: Within-pool dupe of accepted creamy-garlic-herb-wine-pork-chops: same pork-chop / garlic-parmesan cream / skillet / no-starch dinner; the wine-herb sibling won on distinctness + macros.

dishes.name: Creamy Pesto Chicken Pepper Skillet
dishes.reason: Dupe of accepted creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet: both creamy sun-dried-tomato chicken-breast skillets, no starch (4/4 but pesto+peppers vs spinach). Adjudicator recommended dupe; catalog already Italian-American-heavy.

dishes.name: Creamy Pork Chops Pancetta Thyme Gravy
dishes.reason: Overrule adjudicator KEEP: run-dupe of accepted creamy-garlic-herb-wine-pork-chops (creamy skillet pork chops, no starch, differ only in aromatic); pork/creamy-skillet slice saturated, cuisine not widened

dishes.name: Creamy Smothered Onion Pork Chops Skillet
dishes.reason: Dupe of catalog southern-smothered-pork-chops-and-rice: seared pork chops in onion-cream-broth smother; only the rice starch is dropped

dishes.name: Creamy Spinach Mushroom Pork Chops
dishes.reason: Low-carb spinach re-plating of catalog creamy-mushroom-pork-chops (identical mushroom-cream sauce, minus starch, plus spinach) - same re-plating pattern the barbacoa was cut for; also a second creamy pan-sauce pork chop after accepted creamy-garlic-herb-wine-pork-chops. American, no cuisine widening.

dishes.name: Creamy Tuscan Pork Chops
dishes.reason: Catalog dup of marry-me-pork-chops-over-pasta: same sun-dried-tomato parmesan cream chop (Marry Me / Creamy Tuscan are the canonical same-dish pair); pork+sauce+skillet all match.

dishes.name: Keto Turkey Meatloaf
dishes.reason: Upholding adjudicator DUPE of catalog turkey-meatloaf-with-mashed-potatoes (verified present): same protein, ketchup-glazed American meatloaf, oven bake, baked-loaf form - 4/4 identity. Keto binder swap + dropping the starchy side does not change the entree. Borderline low-carb-variant angle noted for audit; run has turkey coverage, not promoting.

dishes.name: Low Carb Cheesy Beef Broccoli Skillet
dishes.reason: Cross-lane same-dinner twin of accepted keto-turkey-broccoli-cheddar-casserole (ground protein + broccoli + cheddar cream sauce, no starch); beef lane already runaway

dishes.name: Low Carb Chicken Bacon Broccoli Cauliflower Bake
dishes.reason: CROSS-LANE dupe of chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake (accepted earlier THIS run - invisible to the adjudicator, whose accepted_slugs_checked listed only creamy-tuscan). Both are low-carb crustless CHICKEN + BACON + CAULIFLOWER + CHEDDAR oven bakes with no starch: same protein, same method, same base, same bacon+cheddar signature - four of four structural axes. Difference is only binder (egg custard vs cream/cream-cheese), added broccoli, and garlic-mustard vs ranch seasoning - a seasoning/veg nuance, not a distinct plate. The ranch bake was accepted first and its own selection note pre-flagged this exact slug as the near-duplicate to reject. Cut.

dishes.name: Low Carb Korean Beef Bulgogi
dishes.reason: Dupe of catalog beef-bulgogi-rice-bowls: same sliced-steak protein, same soy/sesame/sweet-fruit bulgogi marinade, same sear method; only the rice starch is dropped (rubric: same protein+sauce minus starch = one dish). Korean already covered by accepted slow-cooker-korean-galbi-jjim-short-ribs.

dishes.name: Low Carb Unstuffed Cabbage Beef Skillet
dishes.reason: Dupe of catalog unstuffed-cabbage-roll-bowls: same ground-beef + cabbage + tomato deconstructed cabbage-roll skillet; dropping rice + adding cheddar-jack are formulation tweaks. Also pool-dupe of beef-unstuffed-cabbage-skillet.

dishes.name: Sauerbraten German Braised Beef
dishes.reason: Catalog dupe of slow-cooker-sauerbraten-bowls: same German sweet-sour red-wine-vinegar/gingersnap braised beef chuck.

dishes.name: Sausage Cottage Cheese Egg Bake
dishes.reason: OVERRULE of adjudicator KEEP. Cross-lane borderline-dupe of accepted crustless-bacon-gruyere-quiche: both crustless oven-baked pork + egg + cheese no-starch bakes (3-4 of 4 axes; adjudicator could not see that pork acceptance). Also pork was already tied for most-represented protein (4 of 13) with more pork candidates streaming in - not padding a second pork egg bake.

dishes.name: Sausage Spinach Crustless Quiche
dishes.reason: Pool dupe of sausage-cottage-cheese-egg-bake and cross-lane dupe of accepted crustless-bacon-gruyere-quiche: crustless pork + egg + cheese no-starch bake, fat-forward 18g protein (weakest of the three). Only one crustless pork egg bake survives this run (the accepted gruyere quiche).

dishes.name: Senegalese Poulet Yassa

dishes.name: Slow Cooker Beef Short Ribs

dishes.name: Slow Cooker Cuban Mojo Pork

dishes.name: Slow Cooker Red Wine Beef Cheeks

dishes.name: Thai Basil Ground Beef Pad Kra Pao

Thai not a widening cuisine here (run also accepted thai-coconut-curry-pork-shoulder); near-ceiling 632/650 cal + highest carbs in batch (15g); beef lane already heavy.
